true_cause: Release 2026.10.14.2 regenerated the static locale files, and keys went missing for de-DE, fr-FR and ja-JP. The app silently falls back to English for any missing key, so nothing errors. The missing-key warnings start right after the release and not before.

decoys.why_tempting: The customer sees wrong content shortly after a CDN cache TTL change, which looks like stale cache.
decoys.why_wrong: The cache was invalidated at L064 and later requests show cache=MISS serving the new files. The new files themselves are missing the keys.

decoys.why_tempting: It is the only line that says 'timeout' in the logs, so it reads like a failure.
decoys.why_wrong: One timeout, on a recommendations call, unrelated to text on the page.

detection_gap: 5xx rate and latency stayed flat, and the only signal was a sampled WARN about falling back to English. An alert on missing-key or fallback warnings, or a build check that fails when a locale is missing keys that English has, would have caught this before customers did.
